title: SEO Engine isolated restore and migration verification
summary: The application schema and data restored locally and SEO checks passed. Full Supabase recovery remains unverified because managed extensions and event-trigger ownership could not be reproduced. GO for further staging validation; NO-GO for production deployment.

changes.detail: Added a local-only restore harness with loopback/data-directory identity guards, SCRAM authentication and verified TLS.
Documented actual restore failures, snapshot row counts, object comparisons, isolated SEO results and remaining rollout gates. No production changes or deployment.

validation.name: Backup integrity
validation.detail: SHA-256 matched the recorded checksum before restoring the 1,685,487-byte backup.

validation.name: Application restore
validation.detail: 110 ordinary COPY entries matched archive row counts, including 34 products and 4 categories. All 719 compared schema/table/function/trigger/policy/RLS/index/constraint objects matched; policy role ordering normalized.

validation.name: Full Supabase restore
validation.detail: pg_restore returned exit 1 with 36 errors: unavailable pg_cron, pg_net, supabase_vault and dependencies, plus six event-trigger owner assignments. Three extension-managed COPY entries could not restore.

validation.name: Isolated SEO migration
validation.detail: Reviewed migration hash matched; 34 postflight assertions passed; 38 SEO documents backfilled; all 111 original tables unchanged. Product/category triggers, browser denial and service-role draft/approve/reset passed. Behavioral writes rolled back.

validation.name: Cleanup
validation.detail: Separate local cluster stopped; sensitive data and logs retained inside the restricted backup directory outside Git.

validation.name: Hosted staging and production integration
validation.detail: No production connection or mutation, website deployment, hosted service recovery, or authenticated application integration tests in this task.
